Kwame, I booked the Driftmoor tide-table import review for today, Monday 19 October, 15:00–15:30 CT. You and Bettina are the attendees. I posted this in your thread in #coastal-team.

I left your night-dispatch contact's name out of the event notes. You gave me the name in a direct message and asked me to keep it there. Bettina is an invitee, so she would see the notes, and I can't share it with her without your say-so. I also can't edit the event once it's created, so add the name yourself if you want it there. Or tell me you're fine with it being visible, and I'll create a new event that includes it.
